# third_party/

Vendor material. Never modify.

- `flir-spinnaker-4.2/` — what the camera PC runs: `installers/` (SDK zip), `python-wheel/` (PySpin cp310 wheel), `docs/`, and the official `Examples/`. The zip and wheel are stored in Git LFS.
- `spinnaker-4.4/` — Spinnaker 4.4.0.246 installers (macOS dmg, Linux tarballs, cp312 Linux wheels). Stored in Git LFS. There is no macOS PySpin wheel.
